13import socket
14import threading
15from typing import Optional
16
17
18class ScpiTcpClient:
19 """Minimal SCPI-over-TCP client.
20
21 The N6705 data socket listens on TCP port 5025 and expects commands
22 terminated with newline (\n).
23 """
24
25 def __init__(self, host: str, port: int = 5025, timeout_s: float = 3.0) -> None:
26 self._host = host
27 self._port = port
28 self._timeout_s = timeout_s
29 self._socket: Optional[socket.socket] = None
30 self._io_lock = threading.Lock()
31
32 @property
33 def host(self) -> str:
34 return self._host
35
36 @property
37 def port(self) -> int:
38 return self._port
39
40 @property
41 def is_connected(self) -> bool:
42 return self._socket is not None
43
44 def connect(self) -> None:
45 if self._socket is not None:
46 return
47
48 sock = socket.create_connection((self._host, self._port), timeout=self._timeout_s)
49 sock.settimeout(self._timeout_s)
50 self._socket = sock
51
52 def disconnect(self) -> None:
53 sock = self._socket
54 self._socket = None
55 if sock is not None:
56 try:
57 sock.shutdown(socket.SHUT_RDWR)
58 except OSError:
59 pass
60 finally:
61 sock.close()
62
63 def write(self, command: str) -> None:
64 payload = self._format_command(command)
65 with self._io_lock:
66 self._sendall(payload)
67
68 def query(self, command: str) -> str:
69 payload = self._format_command(command)
70 with self._io_lock:
71 self._sendall(payload)
72 data = self._readline()
73 return data
74
75 def _sendall(self, payload: bytes) -> None:
76 if self._socket is None:
77 raise ConnectionError("No hay conexión TCP activa con la fuente")
78 self._socket.sendall(payload)
79
80 def _readline(self) -> str:
81 if self._socket is None:
82 raise ConnectionError("No hay conexión TCP activa con la fuente")
83
84 buffer = bytearray()
85 while True:
86 chunk = self._socket.recv(4096)
87 if not chunk:
88 raise ConnectionError("La conexión TCP fue cerrada por el instrumento")
89 buffer.extend(chunk)
90 if b"\n" in chunk:
91 break
92
93 line, _, _ = buffer.partition(b"\n")
94 return line.decode("ascii", errors="replace").strip()
95
96 @staticmethod
97 def _format_command(command: str) -> bytes:
98 normalized = command.rstrip("\r\n") + "\n"
99 return normalized.encode("ascii")
